fullTextZH: 今天我想说说我小时候的故事。
fullTextEN: Today I want to talk about my childhood stories.

fullTextZH: 小时候，就是我还是孩子的时候。
fullTextEN: Childhood is when I was still a child.
Now I am not a child.

fullTextZH: 我的妈妈说我小时候是个好孩子。
fullTextEN: My mom says I was a good child when I was young.
Because I was not picky about food.
Vegetables, meat, fruits, I eat them all.

fullTextZH: 所以我小时候胖嘟嘟的。
fullTextEN: So I was chubby when I was young.
Because I was not picky about food,
He is very picky about food.
There are many things he doesn't eat.
So my mom is very angry.

fullTextZH: 我的妈妈说：“全部的东西都要吃。”
fullTextEN: My mom said, "You have to eat everything."

fullTextZH: 我的哥哥说：“我不要吃青菜。”
fullTextEN: My brother said, "I don't want to eat vegetables."

fullTextZH: 我的妈妈说：“你不吃青菜就不可以出去玩。
fullTextEN: My mom said, "If you don't eat vegetables, you can't go out to play.

fullTextZH: 你坐在这里，全部吃完全部。”
fullTextEN: You sit here and finish everything."

fullTextZH: 然后我的妈妈就去睡觉了。
fullTextEN: Then my mom went to sleep.

fullTextZH: 她看到哥哥还坐在那里，
fullTextEN: She saw my brother still sitting there,
and the vegetables were still there too.

fullTextZH: 我的哥哥坐了一个小时，
fullTextEN: My brother sat for an hour,
then put the vegetables in his mouth.
Mom was very happy to see it,
She said, "Brother is a good child,
I want to go to the bathroom."
He then went to the bathroom.

fullTextZH: 为什么我的哥哥这次吃青菜了呢？
fullTextEN: why did my brother eat vegetables this time?
Is it because he's afraid of mom?

fullTextZH: 那个时候我也觉得奇怪。
fullTextEN: At that time, I also found it strange.

fullTextZH: 我知道我的哥哥非常讨厌青菜。
fullTextEN: I know my brother really hates vegetables.
He put the vegetables in his mouth,

fullTextZH: 然后去厕所把青菜吐到马桶。
fullTextEN: Then he went to the bathroom to spit the vegetables into the toilet.

fullTextZH: 你觉得我的哥哥这个办法怎么样？
fullTextEN: What do you think of my brother's method?
Your mom says you must eat,

fullTextZH: 你小时候不喜欢吃什么东西呢？
fullTextEN: What didn't you like to eat when you were a child?

fullTextZH: 你的妈妈要你吃不喜欢的东西吗？
fullTextEN: Did your mom make you eat things you didn't like?
This is a story from my childhood.

fullTextZH: 也欢迎你说说你小时候的故事。
fullTextEN: You're also welcome to share your childhood stories.
